article.title: Ecuador: Criminal submission
article.author: Editor
article.content: A chilling aspect of the assault on the people of Ecuador is that it is led by an individual against whom there is strong evidence of links to large-scale drug trafficking: between 2020 and 2025, at least eight large shipments of cocaine—camouflaged in banana crates belonging to the Noboa family and destined for Europe—were seized. The post Ecuador: Criminal submission appeared first on MR Online .
